but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and…
Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
God gave Solomon abundant wisdom and understanding, and very great understanding, even as the sand that is on the…

Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on…
Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be…
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…

If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

translations.web: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
translations.bsb: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
translations.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
translations.asv: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart.
